name: Comical Recovery
text:
Trigger You critically fail a skill check that would cause you to fall Prone, or an enemy succeeds at a skill check that would cause you to fall prone.

---
When you're about to fall, you twirl your arms comically to attempt to keep your balance. Attempt a Performance check check against the same DC of the triggering skill check that you critically failed or the enemy's skill DC for the skill it used to knock you prone.

---
Critical Success You don't fall prone. A creature of your choice adjacent to you finds your performance so funny it can't use reactions for 1 round; this is a mental and emotion effect.

Success You don't fall prone.
